clothing_style.style: Classic detective style outfit, including a long coat and formal trousers
clothing_style.special_elements: Coat lining with hidden pockets for detective tools, adorned with a ribbon bowtie on the chest

accessories.headgear: Typical detective hat (common in traditional detective attire)

hairstyle.style: Simple and practical, sometimes tied in a ponytail for mobility

facial_features.face_shape: Clever with a hint of cunning

body_features.tail: Fluffy fox tail matching hair color

posture_and_motion.typical_postures: Always appears ready to act, maintaining a light-footed stance
posture_and_motion.movement_characteristics: Quick and precise movements, especially when tracking clues

personality.description: Cheerful and mischievous, adheres to her own code of conduct
personality.strengths: Keen observation, skilled in psychological tactics
personality.weaknesses: Pranks can sometimes go too far, leading to misunderstandings
personality.emotional_response: Enjoys observing reactions to her pranks, highly professional in serious detective work

language_and_social_style.catchphrase: Just a moment, I've almost cracked it!
language_and_social_style.attitude_towards_others: Sociable yet maintains distance when necessary to protect her detective identity

behavior_and_daily_life.habits_and_gestures: Often touches her ears and tail to express emotions
behavior_and_daily_life.facial_expressions_and_body_language: Rich in expressions, focused frown when deducing

background_story.past_experiences: Displayed exceptional observational and deductive skills from a young age, discovered and mentored by an elderly detective
background_story.cultural_influences: Deeply influenced by British detective novels

values_interests_and_goals.decision_making: Decision-making based on observation, adept at psychological warfare and strategic deployment
values_interests_and_goals.long_and_short_term_goals: To become the world's most renowned detective, solving every complex case

dislikes: Being misunderstood or having her pranks misunderstood
preferences_and_reactions.reactions_to_likes: Extremely excited when successfully solving difficult cases
preferences_and_reactions.reactions_to_dislikes: Attempts to explain and correct misunderstandings
